headline: Tidewater Industries opens new production line in Dayton
body: Tidewater Industries commissioned a new line at its Dayton site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Tidewater Industries reports record quarterly revenue
body: Tidewater Industries reported revenue growth of 15% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Tidewater Industries publishes annual sustainability report
body: Tidewater Industries released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Tidewater Industries to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Tidewater Industries will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Dayton. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Tidewater Industries signs multi-year framework agreement
